---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or addition to SYNAPSE
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem**
What's missing or limiting today? Describe the problem, not the solution
yet — this makes it easier to spot a simpler fix.

**Proposed change**
What you'd like to see, as concretely as you can.

**Where this fits**
Does this change the Policy Artifact contract, add a Veto invariant, or
introduce a new architectural component? If so, this will likely need an
ADR (see `docs/adr/`) before implementation — mention that here so the
discussion can start there.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't propose them
instead.
